title: Управляющая компания — бывший детский сад
purpose: Transparent central illustration for a green Machi Koro-style card.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the central building miniature, never a complete card.
integration_context.background_requirement: Native RGBA transparency is mandatory; alpha=0 outside the miniature and its compact base. No sky, scenery, card frame, glow, halo, checkerboard, or baked shadow.
integration_context.text_policy: Absolute no-text rule: no letters, numbers, words, signs, labels, graffiti, watermarks, or pseudo-writing anywhere.
integration_context.card_relationship: Compact floating sticker-like miniature with generous empty margin.

style_goal.core_formula: Cute polished Machi Koro tabletop miniature plus a repurposed Soviet municipal building with quietly absurd leftovers.
style_goal.rendering: Chunky simplified geometry, crisp dark outlines, flat color blocks, sparse detail, simple two-tone cel shading; no photorealism.

visual_composition.orientation: Front facade faces slightly right, the building's left side is visible, and depth recedes toward image left.
visual_composition.shape: Low broad two-story former kindergarten converted into an office, compact on a small fenced yard base.
visual_composition.palette: Faded powder blue, dirty cream, dull red roof, multicolor but desaturated playground accents, gray concrete.

content.subject: A housing-management company occupying a repurposed Soviet kindergarten.
content.description: Low broad two-story building with rounded canopy, barred ground-floor windows, mismatched plastic replacement windows, patched roof, external boiler pipe, and a short metal fence.
recognition_details: A tiny faded metal playground rocket remains stranded beside the office, now used to store two brooms and a snow shovel.
A row of miniature children's coat hooks is visible through one window, now overloaded with enormous janitors' key rings.
A dignified maintenance worker in a blue robe waters one heroic marigold beside a stack of spare radiator sections.
content.miniature_base: Small fenced patch of cracked asphalt with one sandbox corner and radiator sections.
content.target_impression: The children left decades ago, but the municipal routine stayed.

anti_patterns: No children, playground crowd, text, full card, background, neighboring buildings, photorealism, dense grime, or clipped content.
Do not show the building's right side; do not make depth recede right.
final_prompt_summary: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent central illustration for a Machi Koro-style establishment card. Generate only an isolated cute tabletop-game miniature of a Russian housing-management company occupying a repurposed Soviet kindergarten. Show a low broad two-story faded powder-blue and dirty-cream building with a rounded canopy, barred ground-floor windows, mismatched plastic replacement windows, patched dull-red roof, external boiler pipe, and short metal fence. Mandatory humorous leftovers: a tiny faded metal playground rocket beside the office is now used to store two brooms and a snow shovel; through one window, a row of miniature children's coat hooks now carries enormous janitors' key rings; a dignified maintenance worker in a blue robe waters one heroic marigold beside a stack of spare radiator sections. No children. Front facade faces slightly right, left side visible, depth recedes left. Cute polished Machi Koro miniature, chunky simplified forms, crisp dark outlines, flat clean colors, sparse detail, simple two-tone cel shading, cold muted palette with restrained faded playground accents. Native RGBA transparency with alpha=0 outside the compact fenced asphalt base; no backdrop, sky, scenery, card furniture, glow, halo, checkerboard, cast shadow, text, letters, numbers, signs, labels, logos, graffiti, pseudo-writing, watermark, clipped content, or photorealism.
